credit: Built in DreamCut as an editable code-built motion graphic; no footage, generated imagery or people.
teachingNote: The Beige Desktop look in three examples on the Illustrated Explainer, at normal speed.

receipt.construction: Each example rendered from .agents/skills/motion-graphics/templates/illustrated-explainer with the built looks.js, look "beige-desktop" and that example's controls in looks.json, by the HyperFrames CLI at 1920x1080, encoded to H.264 1280x720 (CRF 20, no audio) and joined in order.
